watches.name: T54SL - The Gullwing
watches.description: Inspired by the iconic 1954-1963 300SL "Gullwing," the Treiber™ T54SL embodies the spirit of automotive innovation and racing heritage. We honor the car’s legacy by incorporating the 300SL's timeless elements into the T54SL, capturing the elegance and precision that defined this automotive legend.

specsRaw.Color: Alpine White Asphalt Black Strawberry Red Blue-Grey
specsRaw.CASE Diameter: 39 mm Height: 11.9 mm Lug-to-Lug: 45.3 mm Lug Width: 22 mm Material: 316L Stainless Steel Water Resistance: 10 ATM (100 m) Finish: Brushed and Polished Elements Caseback: Exhibition (visible movement)
specsRaw.Isochronism: ±10 sec/day (difference in accuracy between a fully wound and partially wound watch)
specsRaw.Lume: Swiss Super-LumiNova with Green Emission on Hour and Minute hands
specsRaw.Crown Positions 1: Manually Wind 2: Adjust Date 3: Adjust Time
specsRaw.Step 1: Unscrew crown counter-clockwise, until it pops out.
specsRaw.Step 2: Turn the crown counter-clockwise in position 3 to set time. The second hand stops, allowing precise adjustment.
specsRaw.Step 3: In position 2, turn the crown clockwise to set the date. (Avoid adjusting between 10pm and 2am.)
specsRaw.Step 4: Screw the crown back into the case by gently pushing the crown towards the case and turning clockwise.

watches.name: T57BA Blackout Edition - Pièce Unique!
watches.description: Limited to a single example, the Special Blackout Edition of the T57BA retains everything you love about the original—now with a stealthy twist. This one-of-a-kind timepiece features a sleek and durable black Diamond-Like Coating (DLC) applied to the case, caseback, and clasp. It’s paired with a handmade, hand-stitched black Walpier Buttero leather strap, accented by bold red stitching and edge paint, and finished with a matching DLC-coated deployant clasp.

specsRaw.Diameter: 45 mm (many people say that it wears closer to a 42mm watch)
specsRaw.Height: 11 mm, 12.8 mm to top of crystal
specsRaw.Manufacturer/ Model: Swiss Technology Production, STP4-13, modified by Treiber™, in-house to put the day at the 6 o-clock position
specsRaw.Functions: Hours, Minutes, Seconds, Date Indicator, Day Indicator
specsRaw.Crown Positions: 1) Manual Winding, 2) Day & Date Setting, 3) Time Setting
specsRaw.Main Dial: Black Enamel with indices printed with Super-LumiNova lume.
specsRaw.Center Trim: Mirror polished 316L stainless steel, with “Treiber” text printed in black.
specsRaw.Crown Position 1: Manually wind the timepiece by turning the crown clockwise.
specsRaw.Crown Position 2: Turn the crown clockwise to change the date, and counter-clockwise to change the day.
specsRaw.Crown Position 3: Turn the crown counter-clockwise to advance the time.
specsRaw.Colors: The colors of the T57BA’s dials and straps are reminiscent of the unique colors available on the exterior and interior of the ‘57 Bel Air.
